entities.summary: Jasmine Hassell is a professional basketball player who last played for the Indiana Fever of the WNBA. She played college basketball at the University of Georgia. Hassell is a Signature athlete of Hoops Mechanic basketball training and is under contract to play in Israel in 2015/2016.
